title: 第4章  入门考核
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
第二天黄昏，陆渊下了官道，走向不远处的一座牌坊。
牌坊约摸三丈高，正中刻着三个大字：镇魔司。
铁画银钩，笔锋如刀，看之一眼就能感受到扑面而来的凛冽气息。
再往后看，一片宅院依山而建，黑瓦白墙，层层叠叠，最高处的钟楼在夕阳下泛着滚烫红光。
刚一靠近，两名黑衣劲装的守卫目光如鹰扫视而来。
陆渊递上腰牌，守卫核验无误。
“进去吧，顺着青石路走到底。”
走过两进院落，穿过三道月洞门，视线尽头是一栋三层阁楼。
镇妖阁！
首层大门敞开，陆渊信步走入，内部是一个通顶空间。
阳光从天窗倾泻而下，在空气中投下道道光柱，尘埃漂浮其中。
光柱之内，是一个个栩栩如生的妖魔。
有走兽，有鳞介，有禽鸟，有虫豸，有异怪，大小不一，形态各异。
从地面到三楼，沿着四壁，足足上百种。
陆渊环视四周，不惧反喜，眼底迸发兴奋之色。
不，这可是一个个词条啊！
可惜了，如果都是自己杀的该有多好。
“新来的？”
忽然一道声音从旁响起。
陆渊转过头，只见一个中年人站在阁楼外，正上下打量着他。

这人四十来岁，身形清瘦，穿着一身青色常服，手中拿着一本簿册。
他快步上前行礼，“陆渊，见过大人。”
“别叫大人。”中年人摆了摆手，“我姓周，在司内任书吏一职，叫我老周就行，你的腰牌呢？”
陆渊递上腰牌，老周接过，翻开簿册对照了一会儿，“陆渊，云安县人士，忠烈之后......嗯，对上了，跟我来吧。”
走出阁楼，入了院子，二人来到了一间堆满卷宗与簿册的厢房。
落座之后，老周翻开簿册，拿起毛笔，一边问一边记。
“年龄？”
“二十。”
“修的什么功法？”
“县衙发的基础锻体决，练了五年。”
“修为？”
“凡境二层。”
老周笔尖一顿，眼里涌出一抹意外，“五年才凡境二层？”
陆渊点头，“是的。”
你还是的？
老周嘴角一抽，一时间不知道该笑还是该叹气。
写完之后，他放下笔，正色道：“行了，基本情况也记完了，现在跟你说说正事。”
陆渊坐直了身子。
“各州镇魔司，每年从辖下各县选拔新血，不管通过何种方式进来，都得过入门考核这一关。”
“考核主要是两方面，第一，资质，第二，实战。”

“有的武者终其一生无法跨过凡境，有的只能修至初境，有的踏入玄境，究其原因不过是资质高低。”
“那......怎么测？”
“简单。”
老周从袖子里摸出一块尺许长的玉碑，放在桌上。
“手放上去，玉碑越亮，资质越高。”
陆渊看着那玉碑，心中没由来的一紧。
五年凡境二层，他心中本来就对自己没报多少期望。
可万一呢？
有没有可能，其实他是个万中无一的武道天才？
深吸一口气，他伸手按在玉碑上。
玉碑不见丝毫反应，甚至连一点微光都没有。
“不亮是吧？没事，十个新来的八个都不亮。”
老周见状，倒也没有露出不屑或者鄙夷，像是早就猜到一样，顺手将玉碑收入袖中。
“别灰心，没资质也有机会进镇魔司，凡境照样可以杀妖，只是升不了镇魔卫而已。”
扎心了。
陆渊脸上闪过一抹尴尬。
“实战怎么测？”他问道。
“实战......”
老周走出院子，朝远处指了指。
陆渊看去，视线越过层层叠叠的黑瓦白墙，落在了最高处的钟楼。

“钟楼之下是锁妖井，里面关着各地抓来的妖魔，但没成气候。”
“实战主要测战力，量才而用，以免良才蒙尘，庸者涉险，当然了，待遇也会有所差别。”
“末等战力者，领杂役之职，无月俸，住山下草舍，不可接取外务，一月之内须晋入丙等，否则发回原籍。”
“丙等战力者，领镇魔司衙役之职，月俸五两，赏淬体灵液一帖，住山畔茅屋，可协助办差。”
“乙等战力者，领镇魔卫之职，月俸十两，赏通脉丹一枚，住山腰木屋，可接取探查差事或协助办差。”
“甲等战力者，领镇魔校尉之职，月俸三十两，赏蜕凡丹一枚，住山峦别院，可接取斩杀妖魔差事。”
“你没参与选拔，早来了两日，两日之后，才会开启锁妖井进行入门考核。”
陆渊点头，难怪那位大人对他说三日之内前往镇魔司，原来还有入门考核这回事。
他继续问道：“刚才说的那几等战力怎么划分？”
“考核时间一个时辰，斩杀妖魔不足十只是末等，三十只以上是丙等，六十只以上是乙等，九十只以上是甲等。”
倒也是简单明了。
既然是入门考核，想必面对的妖魔也都是凡境。
甲等战力，必须在一个时辰内杀九十只，别说普通人了，即便是一般的天才都做不到这种程度。
看来这入门考核的难度比起新血选拔来只强不弱。
“原来如此，多谢了。”
陆渊道了声谢，前往山脚下的草舍登记入住。
根据老周所说，刚来的新人都被安排在这里，两日后会根据抽签结果分批考核。
陆渊抽到了第三批。
当他来到钟楼时，下方已经聚满了人。
刚一靠近锁妖井，就听到前方传来阵阵惊叹与吹捧。

“这才半个时辰，林辰就已经杀了五十只妖魔了！”
“不止，现在已经五十五只了。”
“太强了！林辰这是要向甲等发起冲击吗？”
“想不到云安县竟有如此高手！”
“六十只了！”
“天爷啊！这势头也太猛了！”
......
陆渊抬头看去，只见锁妖井旁的石碑上，林辰的名字极为醒目，击杀数目已经跳动到六十。
云安县林辰，没错，就是林嫚儿的弟弟。
半个时辰刚过一刻，斩杀六十只妖魔，这个成绩冲击甲等也不是没有可能。
陆渊并没有意外，只是静静等待着。
很快，考核结束，石碑上的文字随之变化。
林辰，斩杀妖魔七十八只，乙等战力。
“太强了！”
虽说后劲不足，但不妨碍众多新人投去羡慕嫉妒的目光。
入门考核虽有三等，但能被评为甲等的不足万一，乙等已是强者，丙等才是常态。
乙等，领镇魔卫之职，对于新人来说无疑是巨大的荣耀。
锁妖井上，众多人影显现，林辰面色倨傲从第二批次之中走出。
这时，他看到了人群中的陆渊，眼中顿时闪过一抹冷意。
“陆渊，你这个卑鄙小人，居然还有脸加入镇魔司！”
content_en:
At dusk the next day, Lu Yuan got off the official road and walked towards an archway not far away.
The archway is about three feet high, with three big characters engraved in the middle: Zhen Mo Si.
The iron painting has a silver hook, and the brush is as sharp as a knife. You can feel the cold breath coming towards your face at a glance.
Looking back, we can see a house built against the mountain, with black tiles and white walls, layer upon layer. The clock tower at the top glows red in the setting sun.
As soon as he got closer, two guards in black uniforms glanced at him like eagles.
Lu Yuan handed over his waist badge, and the guard checked that it was correct.
"Go in and follow the bluestone road to the end."
After walking through two courtyards and passing through three moon cave doors, at the end of the sight is a three-story attic.
Demon-Suppressing Pavilion!
The door on the first floor opened, and Lu Yuan walked in. Inside was a space with a ceiling.
Sunlight pours down from the skylight, casting beams of light in the air, with dust floating in them.
Within the light pillar are lifelike monsters.
There are animals, scales, birds, insects, strange things, all different sizes and shapes.
From the ground to the third floor, along the four walls, there are hundreds of kinds.
Lu Yuan looked around, not afraid of rejoicing, his eyes bursting with excitement.
No, these are individual entries!
What a pity, it would have been better if I had killed them all myself.
"New here?"
Suddenly a voice sounded from the side.
Lu Yuan turned his head and saw a middle-aged man standing outside the attic, looking him up and down.
This man was in his forties, with a thin build, wearing a blue uniform, and holding a book in his hand.
He quickly stepped forward and saluted, "Lu Yuan, I have met you, sir."
"Don't call me Sir." The middle-aged man waved his hand, "My surname is Zhou, and I work as a scribe in the department. Just call me Lao Zhou. Where is your badge?"
Lu Yuan handed over his badge, and Lao Zhou took it. He opened the book and compared it for a while, "Lu Yuan, from Yun'an County, Empress Zhonglie... Well, that's right. Come with me."
After walking out of the attic and entering the courtyard, the two came to a side room filled with files and books.
After sitting down, Lao Zhou opened the book, picked up the brush, and took notes while asking questions.
"Age?"
"Twenty."
"What skills did you practice?"
"I have been practicing the basic physical training techniques issued by the county government for five years."
"Cultivation?"
"Second floor of the mortal realm."
Lao Zhou paused with his pen tip, and there was a hint of surprise in his eyes, "It took five years to reach the second level of the mortal realm?"
Lu Yuan nodded, "Yes."
Are you still there?
The corners of Lao Zhou's mouth twitched, and for a moment he didn't know whether to laugh or sigh.
After finishing writing, he put down his pen and said seriously: "Okay, I've finished recording the basic situation. Now let me talk to you about the business."
Lu Yuan sat up straight.
"The Demon Suppression Division of each state selects new blood from each county under its jurisdiction every year. No matter how they come in, they have to pass the entrance examination."
"The assessment is mainly based on two aspects, first, qualifications, and second, actual combat."
"Some warriors cannot cross the mortal realm throughout their lives, some can only cultivate to the first realm, and some step into the mysterious realm. The reason is just their level of qualifications."
"Then...how to test?"
"Easy."
Lao Zhou took out a jade tablet about a foot long from his sleeve and placed it on the table.
"Put your hand up, the brighter the jade tablet is, the higher your qualifications are."
Lu Yuan looked at the jade tablet and his heart tightened for no reason.
After five years on the second level of the mortal realm, he didn't have much expectations for himself.
But what if?
Is it possible that he is actually a unique martial arts genius?
Taking a deep breath, he stretched out his hand and pressed it on the jade tablet.
The jade tablet showed no reaction at all, not even a glimmer of light.
"It doesn't light up, right? It's okay, eight of the ten newcomers don't light up."
When Lao Zhou saw this, he didn't show any disdain or contempt. He just put the jade tablet into his sleeve as if he had already guessed it.
"Don't be discouraged. You can still get into the Demon Suppressing Division without qualifications. You can still kill demons in the mortal realm, you just can't be promoted to the Demon Suppressing Guard."
Heartbroken.
A flash of embarrassment flashed across Lu Yuan's face.
"Actual combatHow to test? " he asked.
"Actual combat..."
Lao Zhou walked out of the yard and pointed in the distance.
Lu Yuan looked over the layers of black tiles and white walls and landed on the clock tower at the top.
"Under the bell tower is the Demon Locking Well, which contains demons captured from various places, but they have not been used. "
"The main purpose of actual combat is to test combat capabilities and use talents according to their abilities to prevent good talents from being ruined and mediocre talents from being exposed to danger. Of course, the treatment will be different. "
"Those who are in the lowest level of combat ability will be assigned to the position of handymen, without monthly salary, and will live in a thatched hut at the foot of the mountain. They are not allowed to receive foreign affairs. They must be promoted to the third level within one month, otherwise they will be sent back to their place of origin. "
"Those with C-level combat power will be assigned to the post of yamen servants of the Demon Division, with a monthly salary of fifty taels, a reward of body-tempering spiritual liquid, and living in a thatched hut on the mountainside, where they can assist in running errands. "
"Those with B-level combat power will be assigned the post of Demon Guard, with a monthly salary of twelve taels, a reward of a pulse-opening pill, and living in a mountainside wooden house. They can receive exploration errands or assist in running errands. "
"Those with first-class combat ability will be assigned the post of Demon-Suppressing School Lieutenant, with a monthly salary of thirty taels, and a reward of a Mortal Pill. They will live in a separate courtyard in the mountains and be assigned the task of slaying demons. "
"You didn't participate in the selection. You came two days early. Two days later, the Demon Locking Well will be opened for the entrance examination. "
Lu Yuan nodded. No wonder the adult told him to go to the Demon Suppressing Division within three days. It turned out that there was an entrance examination.
He continued to ask: "How to divide the levels of combat power mentioned just now? "
"The assessment lasts for one hour. If you kill less than ten demons, you will be ranked at the bottom level; if you kill more than 30 demons, you will be ranked C; if you kill more than 60 demons, you will be ranked B; and if you kill more than 90 demons, you will be ranked A. "
It's quite simple and clear.
Since it is an entrance examination, the monsters you must face are also in the mortal realm.
Level A combat power requires killing ninety animals within an hour. Not to mention ordinary people, even ordinary geniuses cannot achieve this level.
It seems that the difficulty of this entrance examination is only higher than that of new blood selection.
“That’s it, thank you very much. "
Lu Yuan thanked him and went to check in at the thatched cottage at the foot of the mountain.
According to what Lao Zhou said, the newcomers will be arranged here and will be assessed in batches based on the lottery results two days later.
Lu Yuan drew the third batch.
When he arrived at the bell tower, people were already gathering below.
As soon as he approached the Suoyao Well, he heard bursts of exclamation and compliments coming from the front.
"In just half an hour, Lin Chen has already killed fifty demons! "
“More than that, there are already fifty-five now. "
"Too strong! Is Lin Chen going to attack Class A? "
“I didn’t expect there to be such a master in Yun’an County! "
“Sixty of them! "
“Oh my God! This momentum is too strong! "
...
Lu Yuan looked up and saw Lin Chen's name on the stone tablet next to the Suoyao Well, and the number of kills had jumped to sixty.
Lin Chen from Yun'an County is, yes, Lin Man'er's younger brother.
Just after half an hour, sixty monsters were killed. It was not impossible for this achievement to reach the first level.
Lu Yuan was not surprised, he just waited quietly.
Soon, the assessment ended, and the words on the stone tablet changed accordingly.
Lin Chen, killed seventy-eight demons, second-class combat power.
"Too strong! "
Although his stamina is lacking, it does not prevent many newcomers from casting envious glances.
Although there are three levels in the entrance examination, it is rare to be rated as A-level. B-level is already strong, and C-level is the norm.
Class B, leading the Demon Guard, is undoubtedly a great honor for newcomers.
On the Demon Locking Well, many figures appeared, and Lin Chen walked out of the second batch with an arrogant expression.
At this time, he saw Lu Yuan in the crowd, and a coldness suddenly flashed in his eyes.
"Lu Yuan, you are such a despicable person, you actually have the nerve to join the Demon Suppression Division! "
